Name: Item Bags for Alchemistry
Author: Shakja
Description:
I made these item bags for my own playthrough, and since it's nice to share, I hope they'll be a convenient addon for anyone who might need them. 
Keep in mind, this is not a stand-alone mod. These files are additional .jsons for the mod Item Bags by SlayerDharok and need to be installed manually.

[b]Contents:[/b]

Fishing Bag (for storing fishes, sold by Willy)
Crops bag (for all things seeds and crops, sold by Pierre) 
Forage Bag (for all your witchy forage and monster loot, sold by Pierre)
Artisan Goods Bag (for your processed ingredients, potions and gems, sold by Pierre)
[b]

Installation:[/b]

Extract the JSON files from the provided ZIP archive into your ...Mods\ItemBags\assets\Modded Bags folder. 


All credit goes to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Morghoula]Morghoula[/url] for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22743]wonderful mod[/url]﻿. Thank you for your permission!

The UI mod used in the screenshots is ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface[/url].
